outcome.text: Budget and Finance Committee action: Approved as Amended: Approved the City Administrative Officer report dated November 6, 2026 as Amended, as detailed in the Budget and Finance Committee Report dated November 17, 2026 (Nov 18, 2026)

summary: A City Administrative Officer report on the city's emergency weather response, covering the Winter Shelter Program and the Inclement Weather Program. The Homelessness and Health Committee approved it as amended.
